description: Whether a buy can follow a note before you build it: reasons not_found, not_followable (sell notes), expired (24 h after the note), self (your own note), wrong_coin, too_small (under 1 USDC). A follow counts only when the buy is exact-input, on the note's coin, paid in USDC, at least 1 USDC, within 24 h, from a different wallet, and pays the note's author as referrer; prepare_swap with `follow` builds exactly that.

coin.description: The coin you would buy (0x address)

follower.description: Your wallet, the one that would buy

logIndex.description: Log index of the note's event in that transaction

tx.description: Hash of the trade or launch transaction that carries the note

name: check_follow
